newsitem.title: PERU: Peruvian thieves buy off police with fake notes.
newsitem.headline: Peruvian thieves buy off police with fake notes.

text.p: Peruvian policemen in a remote Andean village received more than they bargained for when thieves allegedly bought them off with forged banknotes.
The police caught the robbers after a late-night car chase through Acostambo in the central highlands, according to Peru's leading daily, El Comercio.
The officers decided not to lock them up after pocketing a "thick wad" of cash, witnesses told the paper.
But they discovered the next morning they had been conned.
